e.title: QuantLib
e.summary: 开源量化金融库：资产建模（利率/期权/曲线），Solvency II/IFRS 17 资产侧配套
e.body: QuantLib（lballabio，GitHub 6k★+）是开源量化金融库：利率曲线、期权定价、资产/负债建模工具，可与 modelx/heavylight 集成做资产侧建模（官方博客有 QuantLib × modelx 资产建模示例；QuantLib 社区有 Solvency II 应用演示）。对 RIAA：精算资产侧的成熟开源库——Solvency II/IFRS 17 需要资产情景与经济假设（同 [[esg-generator-python]] 的情景生成谱系）；与 [[modelx]]（建模框架集成）、[[ifrs17a]]（负债侧）配合构成资产-负债双翼；金融工程/ALM 课程的标准工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 确认（开源量化金融库 + modelx 集成/Solvency II 应用），未实测
e.summary_en: Open-source quantitative finance library: asset modelling (rates/options/curves), the asset-side companion for Solvency II/IFRS 17
e.summary_hk: 開源量化金融庫：資產建模（利率/期權/曲線），Solvency II/IFRS 17 資產側配套
e.body_en: QuantLib (lballabio, 6k+ GitHub stars) is an open-source quantitative finance library: interest-rate curves, option pricing and asset/liability modelling tools, integrable with modelx/heavylight for asset-side modelling (the official blog shows QuantLib × modelx asset modelling; the QuantLib community has Solvency II application demos). For RIAA: the mature open-source library on the actuarial asset side — Solvency II/IFRS 17 need asset scenarios and economic assumptions (sharing the scenario-generation lineage of [[esg-generator-python]]); with [[modelx]] (modelling integration) and [[ifrs17a]] (the liability side) it forms the asset-liability pair; the standard tool for financial-engineering/ALM courses.
e.body_hk: QuantLib（lballabio，GitHub 6k★+）是開源量化金融庫：利率曲線、期權定價、資產/負債建模工具，可與 modelx/heavylight 集成做資產側建模（官方博客有 QuantLib × modelx 資產建模示例；QuantLib 社區有 Solvency II 應用演示）。對 RIAA：精算資產側的成熟開源庫——Solvency II/IFRS 17 需要資產情景與經濟假設（同 [[esg-generator-python]] 的情景生成譜系）；與 [[modelx]]（建模框架集成）、[[ifrs17a]]（負債側）配合構成資產-負債雙翼；金融工程/ALM 課程的標準工具。
